question: Up to what plant size may Member States give priority dispatch to electricity from high-efficiency cogeneration?

verdict.gold_reason: Article 12(4) of Regulation 2019/943 says Member States may provide priority dispatch for electricity from high-efficiency cogeneration with an installed electricity capacity of less than 400 kW, which matches the reference answer.

other_articles.why: Article 31(4) lets a Member State require DSOs to give priority to high-efficiency cogeneration but states no size limit; it refers to Article 12 of Regulation 2019/943.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The 400 kW limit is the main case. Article 12(5) lowers the renewables limit to 200 kW from 2026 but does not change the cogeneration limit, and Article 12(6) grandfathers existing facilities. Neither affects the question as asked.
